sources.excerpt: 2008 YA dystopia, first of the trilogy, told from 16-year-old Katniss's perspective in post-apocalyptic Panem in former North America. She volunteers for a televised fight to the death; male tribute Peeta. Themes: survival, poverty, oppression; she lost her father. 2012 film.
